children: Innventure entered into an At The Market Offering Agreement with Lucid Capital Markets to sell up to $60 million of common stock from time to time. Lucid will act as sales agent or principal, with tiered commissions of 3.0% on the first $15 million and 2.17% on the next $45 million, and sales may be made on Nasdaq or through approved private transactions. Innventure plans to use proceeds for working capital and to advance its strategic shift toward Accelsius, including potentially acquiring additional Accelsius units. The agreement is at-will and may be terminated by the company on five business days' notice or by Lucid at any time.
